name: Fail2Ban_AbuseIPDB
notes: v1.5.3: optional automatic failover with a witness arbiter (health endpoint included), TLS for the coordinator from the standard library, Prometheus and JSON snapshots (--metrics, --metric), a ready Zabbix 8.0 module (21 items, 8 triggers, per-server services), retries with backoff for follower syncs, and two end-to-end checks that can fail: tools/verify-failover-tls.sh and tools/zabbix-drill.ps1.
